build_extraction_vlm_pipeline: build an ExtractionVlmPipeline instance with VlmExtractionPipelineOptions to extract structured data from PDF documents using a VLM model
run_extract_data: run the _extract_data method on an ExtractionResult to extract structured JSON data from document pages using a VLM model
run_determine_status: run the _determine_status method on an ExtractionResult to determine if extraction succeeded, partially succeeded, or failed
run_get_images_from_input: run the _get_images_from_input method on an InputDocument to extract page images from a PDF document backend
run_get_default_options: run the get_default_options class method to create default VlmExtractionPipelineOptions for initializing the pipeline
